| 6 | s_byte | go-s_byte | 0002351c0000 | 01:56:28.365 to 01:56:28.507 | status 0, completed 1, no abort/cmd_err | serial 1c35/16: no trigger, exit 16 |
| 7 | ctl_both | go-ctl_both | 000238ac0000 | 02:01:22.222 to 02:01:22.503 | status 0, completed 1, no abort/cmd_err | **EXCLUDED**: GO delivered after capture expired (01:59:10.710Z); emitted to un-armed analyzer; inconclusive scheduling |
